author: openclimatefix
description:
Dataset Card for DWD ICON Global Forecast
	

This dataset is comprised of forecasts from the German Weather Service's (DWD) ICON-Global model from March 2023 to the present with all variables included. Each forecast runs up to 4 days into the future, and the model is ran 4 times per day. This data is an archive of 
the publicly available data at https://opendata.dwd.de/weather/nwp/, converted to Zarr format with Xarray. No other processing of the data is performed.

	
		
	
	
		Dataset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/openclimatefix/dwd-icon-global.
